_doc: Seed D: the owner-chase loop (scripts/tracking/chase.py) as a chain of operators the record is read against before a step fires (agent/preconditions.py explain / applicable). The chase item is the record: its sends / first_sent / last_sent counters read as outreach history, as_of is stamped by the loop each tick. UNKNOWN (a stale or unstamped record) never advances; MOOT (answered, dropped) fires nothing; the plain-words reading rides on the nudge as its advice. Every step stays what it was: a line or a card for the owner, nothing sent to anyone.

operators.script: one nudge line (or card) to the owner about the item that waits on them
the same ask once more, a day or more later, when nothing came back
no more cards: the item rides the daily folded line until the owner answers or park_days pass
